svg.title: RunyShark · Hall of fame
svg.desc: Trophy cabinet, hardest first. Podium: SSS Rank Hacker (Secret): Secret trophy, unlocked by an SSS-rank God Committer; Pull Shark (Gold ×4): Top tier, earned with 1,685 merged pull requests; God Committer (SSS rank): 57,227 commits, the highest commit rank. Also earned: Super Puller (S rank): 1,755 pull requests, 96% merged; Unbroken streak (Record): 223 weeks in a row, since Jul 2022; Best day (Record): 1,866 contributions on Feb 2, 2026; Rainbow Lang User (Secret): 8 languages shipped across repositories; Village Elder (Secret): 5 years on GitHub, since Oct 2021; Pair Extraordinaire (Bronze ×2): Co-authored pull requests, merged; Quickdraw (Unlocked): Closed an issue or PR within 5 minutes; YOLO (Unlocked): Merged a pull request without a review.
